locality.description: Locality information is missing for all records.

elevation.description: Elevation data missing for all records.

speciesKey.description: Constant species identifier for Cingilia catenaria records.

collectionCode.description: Record type is observations for each occurrence entry.

recordNumber.description: Unused identifier field containing only missing values.

typeStatus.description: No information available for this attribute.
